## Activity

During February 2023, North City Eye Clinic recorded 487 captures. Activity proceeded routinely across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below. No additional operational exception is noted in the available report.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 13 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.7. The result indicates that most submitted images were suitable for assessment. Ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine review so that any recurring issues with capture conditions, equipment, or patient positioning can be identified and addressed through normal site processes.

## Grading

Grading identified 119 referable results during the month. The median lag from photograph to grade was 1 days. This reflects the central turnaround for completed grading and should be considered alongside the volume of captures and the number of images requiring further assessment. Overall, the report records routine site activity, a low proportion of ungradable images, and a defined group of referable results requiring the established follow-up pathway.
